findings: Rectal resection: APC p.V450fs loss-of-function frameshift at 8.6% variant allele fraction; no reported pathogenic KRAS, NRAS or BRAF variant or copy-number change.
Microsatellite stable; low tumour mutational burden, 4.2 mutations/Mb. No reportable RNA rearrangement or altered splicing.
No potential germline variant reported within the limited gene set. Somatic variants of unknown significance included CCDC6, ELF3, SMARCA4 and SOX9.
DPYD: none of five targeted variants detected. UGT1A1 *1/*28: predicted intermediate metabolizer; insufficient evidence for a dose change based on this genotype alone.
result_summary.note: Results concern historical rectal resection and matched-normal blood. Limited germline analysis does not exclude hereditary cancer risk.

findings: KRAS, NRAS and BRAF mutations not detected; microsatellite stable; low tumour mutational burden, 5 mutations/Mb.
Pathogenic APC p.S1411fs and p.V450fs, PTEN p.R335* and SOX9 c.432-2A>T; likely pathogenic SMARCA4 p.D1177Y.
ERBB2/HER2 and EGFR amplification and NTRK1/2/3, BRAF and RET fusions not detected. Low genomic loss of heterozygosity, 5%.
Predicted HLA-A A*02:01 / A*02:01; HLA-B B*07:02 / B*44:02; HLA-C C*03:04 / C*05:01. HLA-A loss of heterozygosity not detected.

result_summary.note: The superficial biopsy was predominantly intramucosal carcinoma and may not represent invasive or metastatic disease. FOLFIRSTai is a signature result, not evidence I received bevacizumab.

records.title: StoreMyTumor tissue processing and storage report
records.description: One-page processing report documenting banked cryopreserved fragments. I identify this as my recent nodal biopsy; the report itself does not state the anatomical site.
records.provenance_summary: Primary processing report reviewed 20 October 2026. Inventory is directly documented; nodal linkage is patient-reported. I confirmed on 20 October 2026 that the printed collection date 10/6/2026 means 6 October 2026.
records.preparation: Rasterized public copy with banking account number removed. Clinical and inventory pixels outside that field are unchanged. Original hidden text, annotations and document metadata omitted.

findings: Collected material: 2 vials labelled Tumor in Media (viable), and 0 vials of fixed tumour in formalin. This is the received-material inventory, not additional current fresh stock.

Banked cryopreserved tissue: 10 vials with 2 fragments per vial, plus 4 vials with 10 fragments per vial. Calculated total: 14 vials and 60 fragments; each fragment is reported as about 1-2 mm in diameter.
Cryopreserved cells and flash-frozen tissue are marked NA. Blood plasma and PBMC are each recorded as 0 vials.

Collection date is 6 October 2026, interpreting the printed 10/6/2026 as confirmed by me on 20 October 2026. The report does not state the anatomical site and leaves cancer type, surgeon and hospital blank.
No post-thaw viability, cell recovery, tumour fraction, pathology result, paired TCR sequence or molecular target is reported.
result_summary.basis: Primary report transcription with explicitly labelled arithmetic totals; collection-date interpretation follows patient clarification on 20 October 2026.
result_summary.note: Storage confirms material was banked; suitability for paired single-cell TCR/RNA, functional assays or treatment has not been demonstrated. N/A and blank fields retain their original meanings.

records.related_data_label: Tissue inventory and proposed assay assessment
limitations: Collection date is printed as 10/6/2026. On 20 October 2026 I confirmed this means 6 October 2026; the normalized date follows this patient clarification.
The report leaves surgeon, hospital and cancer-type fields blank and does not state an anatomical site. Its linkage to my clavicular/supraclavicular-node biopsy is patient-reported.

Tumor in Media (viable) is a collected-material label. The report gives no measured post-thaw viability, recoverable cell count, tumour fraction, histological confirmation, culture sterility or assay suitability.
The two collected media vials are not two additional currently banked fresh vials. Their relationship to the processed inventory is not specified.
N/A is preserved as reported, rather than converted to a measured zero. The blank Blood, Formalin and Ascites fluid (leaked in bag) fields do not establish collection, storage or a leak event.

Fragment counts and approximate diameters do not establish tissue mass, malignant-cell yield or successful receptor discovery. This is a processing/storage record, not a pathology or molecular result.

records.title: B7_43 Proteomics Explorer
records.description: Original interactive research report of archived rectal-primary FFPE proteomics. The 29 October quantitative reanalysis adds the processed intensity and peptide matrices, audits the controls and updates therapeutic interpretation.
records.provenance_summary: B7 block maps to the treated rectal resection, independently distinguished from B4 in pathology and Natera records. The _43 suffix/exact section is unresolved. No laboratory or report date is stated in the supplied HTML.
records.preparation: Original self-contained HTML preserved byte-for-byte; source and script review found no external resource dependencies or identifying administrative fields. Original drug-database labels remain source content and are not clinical eligibility determinations.

specimens.label: Archived rectal resection block B7; exact _43 section unresolved

findings: Orbitrap Astral DIA mass spectrometry: 7,706 protein groups, including 6,468 meeting the report’s confident-detection rule.

Selected proteins include CDH17 (22 unique peptides), PTK7 (19), FAP (14), GPA33 (9), B7-H3/CD276 (5) and CEA/CEACAM5 (3). These counts describe identification support, not comparable protein abundance.
The report’s antibody/ADC target panel contains 41 detected targets; no usable matched healthy-tissue comparator was available.

The 29 October audit identifies the AO control as Human Protein Atlas colon data from one healthy donor with three tissue measurements. CPTAC and other cohort comparisons are external context; they are not matched-normal measurements from this patient.
result_summary.basis: Supplied report: Summary, Targets, Methods and limits, Protein explorer.
result_summary.note: Historical mixed FFPE specimen. Automated drug mappings include mutation-, fusion- and indication-specific therapies; detection alone is not eligibility. See Potential therapeutics for cross-assay interpretation and current trial caveats.
result_summary.section: Summary, Targets, Methods and limits, Protein explorer

records.related_data_label: Quantitative reanalysis, data and therapeutic interpretation
limitations: Research proteomics, not a clinically validated companion diagnostic.

Processed intensity and peptide matrices became available on 29 October 2026. Raw spectra were not retrieved; exact section, tumour fraction, acquisition metadata and full identification/quantification error-control outputs remain unresolved.
Specimen collected in 2024; current nodal tumour and stroma may differ.
Run 423 has unknown biological identity and must not be treated as normal tissue. The separate AO control matches HPA colon data from one healthy donor, not a matched-normal cohort.
Detection, peptide counts and exploratory cross-study signal ranks do not establish cell-surface density, patient-versus-normal fold change or drug sensitivity.

records.title: B7_43 quantitative proteomics: data, reference comparisons and therapeutic review
records.description: Independent audit of the supplied processed DIA protein/peptide matrices, conservative gene mapping, tissue-composition sensitivity, public reference cohorts and therapeutic relevance. Includes downloadable data, methods and provenance.
records.provenance_summary: Run FZPR260000422 is labelled B7_43. B7 maps to the treated rectal resection; the exact _43 section and tumour fraction remain unresolved. Processed Novogene delivery was independently reanalysed; no raw-spectra search was performed.
records.preparation: Portable public derivative of the completed local analysis. Scientific figures are separate assets; private filesystem links are replaced with public report/data references. Original input and derivative hashes are distinguished.
records.browse_type: Quantitative protein evidence and reference comparisons

specimens.label: Archived rectal resection block B7; exact _43 section unresolved

findings: 7,755 protein groups in the matrix; 7,706 with positive run-422 signal. Strict mapping retains 6,465 genes across 6,468 groups; a separately labelled sensitivity analysis retains 6,487 genes.

FAP and LRRC15 support stromal-target investigation; CDH17 and PTK7 have strong peptide support. CEA liver IHC remains direct target-distribution evidence. Bulk protein ranks cannot establish current malignant-cell membrane density.
Run 423 is unidentified. The AO control is a one-donor HPA colon reference. No patient-versus-normal differential-expression significance or validated patient iBAQ was established.
Public Astral CRC, Komor CRC/normal, CPTAC and iBAQ cohorts provide separate context. Tissue composition and platform effects materially affect the comparisons.
ARR-217/MRG007 adds a CDH17 ADC trial option; FAP radioligand and immune combinations remain investigational. Protein detection alone creates no new approved indication.
result_summary.basis: Processed source matrices, independent peptide audit, public reference comparisons and primary therapeutic sources reviewed 29 October 2026.
result_summary.note: Exploratory research analysis of archival mixed FFPE tissue. Trial access and current-tissue assays require separate confirmation.
